name: Metaball morph
looks: A blob splits into about eight smaller blobs drifting inside a thin outline that morphs through several shapes in turn, such as a circle, a triangle, a star and an organic form. The blobs then merge back into a single dot that grows into a wipe to the next scene.
build: Resample every target shape to the same number of perimeter points and interpolate point by point between them on a power3 in-out ease, one morph per beat, writing the result into one SVG path's d attribute every frame from the clock; render the blobs as circles under a gooey blur-and-threshold filter sitting at points along the morphing outline.
sound: A soft wobble under the split, a tick on each outline change, a swell into the merge, and a whoosh on the wipe.
prompt: Split a shape into a cluster of small blobs drifting inside a thin outline that morphs through several silhouettes in sequence, then merge the blobs back into one point that grows into a wipe to the next scene. Let the shapes carry real meaning, such as an icon, a mark or a letter, rather than being arbitrary geometry.
source: the 2026 Opus showreels; built in examples/reel-2026-10-06.html, S8.
